theme_and_archetype.reasoning: Logistics and dispatch command centers demand clarity, authority, and function-first design. The client reported feeling 'dizzy from too much red'. By shifting to a high-contrast Swiss archetype, we establish a premium 'control room' feel using deep slate and white as primary structural colors, while reserving the brand's red strictly for critical alerts (e.g., urgent preparation timers, delayed drivers).

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: MODE B: THE 'CONTROL ROOM' GRID. Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or 12-col data grids. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) for widget density.
spacing_and_layout.containers: Use max-w-[1600px] mx-auto for the main dashboard view, ensuring edge-to-edge data utility on large dispatch screens.

borders_and_radius.radius: rounded-lg (subtle 8px radius, avoiding overly bubbly shapes)

admin_dispatch_dashboard.layout: Collapsible left sidebar (bg-slate-900 text-white) with an expansive main content area. Top-left quadrant dedicated to 'North Star' operational metrics (Active Drivers, Pending Orders, Average Prep Time).
admin_dispatch_dashboard.live_map: Desaturated, grayscale map style (to make operational data pop). Remove delivery polygons entirely to reduce clutter. Use high-contrast custom map markers (slate for idle, red for delayed/urgent, green for active delivery) for drivers and restaurants.

restaurant_management_and_analytics.layout: Bento Grid architecture. Cards for KPIs (Total Orders, Avg Prep Time, Revenue). Use line charts (Recharts) with a monochromatic slate palette and one red highlight line for anomalies.
restaurant_management_and_analytics.delivery_zones: Dedicated configuration modal or split-screen map view for admins to draw/adjust radius/polygons per restaurant, separate from the main live dispatch map.
restaurant_management_and_analytics.program_and_slots: Tabular or calendar-like grid. Normal vs. Emergency schedules represented by subtle color coding (e.g., Red-50 bg for emergency slots, Slate-50 for normal) instead of overwhelming solid colors.

preparation_timer.visuals: Must be highly legible and strictly color-coded based on time remaining.
states: Normal (Plenty of time): Slate-900 text, simple countdown font-mono.
Urgent (Late/Critical): Red-600 text with a subtle pulsing animation.
preparation_timer.component: Circular progress indicator or a pill-shaped badge fixed in the restaurant queue view.

buttons_and_inputs.primary_cta: Solid Slate-900. No heavy gradients. 1px inner highlight if needed.
buttons_and_inputs.inputs: Shadcn default inputs, hover:border-slate-400, focus:ring-slate-900 focus:border-slate-900. Square or slightly rounded (rounded-md).

icons_and_assets.weight: duotone for navigation, regular for dense data tables

motion_and_interactions.general: Minimal, functional animations. The app must feel instantaneous.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-[1px]) with enhanced shadow (shadow-md).
motion_and_interactions.data_updates: Use subtle background flash (bg-slate-100 to transparent) when a row in the dispatch table updates live.
motion_and_interactions.timers: Urgent timers should have a slow, non-aggressive pulse (animate-pulse) on the red indicator.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text against Slate-50 or White meets 4.5:1 ratio (APCA preferred).
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Examples: data-testid='dispatch-assign-driver-button', data-testid='timer-urgent-alert'.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The overarching goal is to remove the 'too much red' feeling. Red MUST ONLY be used for destructive actions, urgent preparation timers, or delayed delivery alerts. Use Slate-900 as the primary 'brand' interaction color.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for structural layout and deeply customize Shadcn components (tables, inputs, dialogs, dropdowns) to have a 1px border, shadow-sm, and rounded-lg styling.
The Live Map should not show delivery polygons. Keep the map UI purely for tracking Driver and Restaurant locations in real-time.
For the Schedule (Program/sloturi), implement a clean matrix/calendar using native HTML/Tailwind grids and Shadcn cards, avoiding heavy colored backgrounds.
Add Recharts for the Restaurant Analytics section. Keep the charts monochromatic (slate/grey scales) with red used ONLY to highlight negative anomalies.
